content: Web push gotchas: many desktop browsers must be running (background process) to receive push with tab closed — macOS Chrome/Firefox often deliver only while browser process alive; subscriptions expire/revoke (handle 404/410 by pruning); success = delivered to push service (FCM/autopush), not to device; TTL expiry silently drops; OS-level focus/DND modes suppress display. Email backup essential. Email deliverability: new domains on free-tier senders (Resend) land in spam without SPF/DKIM/DMARC and domain warm-up; alert-style emails with many job links resemble spam patterns.
